description: CVEmber score, 0-100, for a saved resume (resumeId) or a pasted one (content, works signed out; not saved): completeness, readability, match to a job ad when given, and how much the lines show. Partial = not fully read.

content.description: A pasted resume (contact, summary, experience, education, skills), when there is no resumeId.

keywords.description: Keywords from the job ad to check for; read from the ad when omitted.

name: score_resume
title: Check resume
